subject: SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph
notes: Rule: 'When the ALPHABET clause is specified with neither the ALPHANUMERIC phrase nor the NATIONAL phrase, the ALPHANUMERIC phrase is implied.' cite.py --check 12.3.7.3 -> OK §12.3.7.3 13). ForPhraseIsNational returns NATIONAL only when the phrase says so; the unmarked clause takes the alphanumeric branch and the SR14 b-rules. Probes: sr13_implied_nat_lit (`ALPHABET AL IS N"C" N"B"`) and sr13_explicit_nat_lit (`FOR ALPHANUMERIC`) draw the identical COBOL1906 SR14 b2 diagnostics; sr13_implied_ok runs as a PCS (C,B,A at positions 1-3); sr13_implied_pcs_nat refuses the implied-alphanumeric alphabet as PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE FOR NATIONAL (COBOL0898, §12.3.6.3 SR2) - the implied class is carried downstream, not just to the operand rules. No existing test pins implied == explicit; test-ref empty.
